units.source_text: “是客人送的，我把它放在袖兜里或夹在腰带里带回来的。

en.t: They were given to me by guests, and I brought them back tucked in my sleeve pocket or slipped into my sash.

units.source_text: 都成了这样皱皱巴巴的，但是并不脏。

en.t: They have all gotten wrinkled like this, but they are not dirty.

units.source_text: 种类倒是大体上都齐全了。”

en.t: As for the varieties, though, I have more or less collected them all.

units.source_text: 她一只手支在岛村面前，另一只手乱翻起盒子里的香烟让岛村看。

en.t: She propped one hand in front of Shimamura and, with the other, rummaged through the cigarettes in the box to show him.
